title: Kosis, the Revelation Boss Guide: Simulacrum Waves, Demon Beam, Shield and Boss+Add Priority
summary: Path of Exile 2 Delirium / Simulacrum boss guide: where Kosis appears, wave context, Demon Beam direction, shield/recovery, priority vs Omniphobia, and reward/exit judgement.
description: Beat Kosis, the Revelation in PoE2 Simulacrum. Wave context, shield mechanic, Demon Beam safe sector, boss+add priority matrix, community evidence and rewards.
author: Exile2 Guides Editorial Team
imageAlt: Kosis, the Revelation — Simulacrum boss art

sections.title: Remember These First
sections.callout: In the Simulacrum, never chase Kosis into the swarm — the wave monsters will surround you. Kill the priority target (often Omniphobia or the add) first, then Kosis.
calloutDetail: Kosis appears in Map Delirium and the Simulacrum. The Simulacrum version shares difficulty scaling with the wave you are on; the more Delirium, the harder he hits.
His Demon Beam is directional — move to the safe sector opposite the beam origin. He also has a shield/recovery phase that needs specific handling.

sections.title: Top search questions: entry, materials, failure cost

items.question: Is the Map Delirium Kosis the same difficulty as the Simulacrum one?
answer: Both are the same boss, but the Simulacrum version scales with the wave number and Delirium intensity, while Map Delirium depends on map modifiers. Expect the Simulacrum fight to be denser and harder per wave.

items.question: How do wave, Delirium intensity, and co-spawning enemies affect the fight?
answer: Higher waves and intensity mean more adds, tighter space, and harder hits. Kosis frequently shares the arena with Omniphobia or trash; treat the wave as the environment, not a clean 1v1.

items.question: Does his shield / recovery need special handling?
answer: Yes — during his recovery/shield window he is harder to damage or briefly invulnerable. Burn him before it, or reposition and clear adds, then resume. Do not dump your whole rotation into the shield.

items.question: Why do I get surrounded when I chase him?
answer: Chasing Kosis pulls you into the wave monsters. Keep your position, let him come to you, and use the beam safe sector to create space.

items.question: When Kosis and Omniphobia appear together, who do I kill first?
answer: Omniphobia first — its charges/slams are the bigger positional threat. Then Kosis. The beam safe sector still applies to Kosis.

steps.label: Enter Delirium / Simulacrum
body: Run a Delirium map or start a Simulacrum. Kosis spawns as a wave boss, not a fixed arena.

steps.label: Reach his wave
body: In the Simulacrum he appears at specific waves; in maps he appears during the Delirium encounter.

sections.title: Wave Context
paragraphs: Kosis is a wave-environment boss. In the Simulacrum, each wave increases Delirium intensity; he shares the floor with trash and sometimes Omniphobia. The wave is the arena — you cannot kite him into a clean corner because the swarm fills it.
Read the Wave Context bar: know which wave you are on and whether Omniphobia or adds are present before committing damage. Tighten your positioning as intensity rises.
bullets: Wave scales his HP/hits and add count.
Space shrinks as Delirium intensity rises.
He is rarely a clean 1v1 — plan for overlap.

sections.title: Boss + Add Priority System
paragraphs: When Kosis overlaps with Omniphobia or trash, use a priority matrix: (1) Omniphobia's charges/slams are the biggest positional threat — kill or disable it first; (2) then Kosis during his vulnerable window; (3) trash only if it blocks your safe sector. Chasing Kosis into the swarm is the most common death.
If Kosis is alone, still respect his shield window and the beam safe sector; don't over-commit your burst.
bullets: Omniphobia (if present) > Kosis vulnerable window > trash.
Never chase Kosis into the swarm.
Use the beam safe sector to create space, not to close distance.

items.label: Capped Chaos Resistance
items.why: Kosis deals Chaos; uncapped means rapid death in the swarm.

items.label: Area damage / clear
items.why: Wave monsters surround you if ignored.
items.fix: AoE skills, prolif, or minions for add control.

items.label: Mobility
items.why: You must create space with the beam safe sector.

items.label: Burst for shield windows
items.why: Over-committing into the shield wastes your rotation.
items.fix: Hold burst for the vulnerable window.

phases.label: Wave-Scaled Encounter
phases.trigger: Spawns during a Delirium / Simulacrum wave.
notes: No fixed phase split; difficulty is set by wave number and Delirium intensity. His shield/recovery window punctuates the fight.
The beam safe sector is your main space-maker.

attacks.name: Demon Beam
telegraph: Kosis channels a beam that fires in a direction.
responses: Move to the safe sector opposite the beam origin; do not cross the line.
notes: Directional; the safe sector is opposite the origin.

attacks.name: Shield / Recovery
telegraph: He enters a shield or recovery stance.
responses: Reposition and clear adds; resume burst after the window.
notes: Don't dump rotation into the shield.

attacks.name: Jump / Slam
responses: Dodge-roll out of the slam radius.

attacks.name: Explosion
telegraph: A delayed explosion telegraphs at a location.
responses: Leave the marked area before it fires.

sections.title: Arena Reading
paragraphs: There is no dedicated arena — Kosis fights you inside the Delirium/Si mulacrum wave space, which is crowded with mist and adds. The mist limits visibility, so the beam telegraph and audio cues matter more than ever.
Keep near the edge of the cleared space; do not run to the centre where the swarm concentrates.
bullets: Fight inside the wave, not a clean boss room.
Use the beam safe sector to push adds away.
Watch the mist — telegraphs are easy to miss.

sections.title: Build Considerations
paragraphs: Area damage and add control are essential because the wave never stops. Cap Chaos res. The beam safe sector rewards kiting builds; melee must time bursts around his shield. Minions help hold the swarm but can body-block your own dodges.
Delirium intensity rises — your damage must scale or you will time out the wave.
bullets: Melee: burst during vulnerable window; respect shield.
Ranged: kite using beam safe sector; AoE the swarm.
Minion: great for add control; watch body-block.
All: cap chaos res, scale damage with intensity.

entries.question: Why do I get surrounded chasing Kosis?
summary: Players report chasing him into the wave swarm. Community fix: hold position, use beam safe sector for space.
editorialAnalysis: We confirm: the wave is the arena; chasing pulls you into adds. Hold ground, let him come.
officialAnswer: Don't chase. Hold position; use the beam safe sector to make space.

entries.question: Why is his health bar / UI weird?
summary: Forum posts note Simulacrum boss bars can misrender; don't read mechanics from the UI glitch.
editorialAnalysis: Our note: UI glitches are presentation only; trust the in-game telegraphs, not the bar.
officialAnswer: UI bar glitches are cosmetic — rely on telegraphs, not the bar.

problems.symptom: I get surrounded and die in the swarm
directAnswer: Hold your position; use the beam safe sector to create space; clear adds with AoE instead of chasing.

problems.symptom: My burst does nothing during his shield
directAnswer: Reposition and clear adds during the shield; save burst for the vulnerable window after.

problems.symptom: The boss bar looks wrong / UI glitch
directAnswer: UI glitches are cosmetic; trust the in-game telegraphs, not the bar readout.
